author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
I wiped my bare-metal system and rebuilt it from the ground up with Fedora Server, a minimal X/DWM/Quickshell desktop, GPU passthrough, bridge networking, Looking Glass, development tools, DaVinci Resolve, Steam, and the real-world fixes that come with doing this on actual hardware.

This is not a clean VM demo. This is the messy, advanced, real install with multiple drives, multiple GPUs, PCI passthrough, weird display issues, missing packages, broken libraries, and all the troubleshooting that makes Linux installs interesting.

Do not blindly copy this setup. Use it to see the decisions, tradeoffs, and problems you may run into when building a serious Fedora workstation/server from scratch.
